item.title: Bahama Breeze in Virginia Beach set to close
item.description: VIRGINIA BEACH, Va. (WAVY)-- Darden Restaurants announced their Bahama Breeze location in Virginia Beach will be closing. The company says it will be permanently closing all 28 Bahama Breeze restaurants but plan to convert 14 locations into another Darden brand.
